result.instructions: Tools for IRIS CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which leads did we add this week, and who owns them?"; "Show the notes on lead 1234, newest first."; "List our merchants that were created in the last 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes IRIS CRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run iriscrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run iriscrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run iriscrm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. iriscrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: iriscrm_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List CRM leads (sales prospects) with filters by group, merchant id, campaign, source, status, status category, owner user, and a date range. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /leads.

sort_by.description: Lead field to sort by (see iriscrm_list_lead_fields).

date_filter.description: Which date the start and end dates apply to.

start_date.description: Start of the date range (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 date-time).

end_date.description: End of the date range (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 date-time).

tools.name: iriscrm_get_lead
tools.title: Get a lead
tools.description: Get one lead with its field values (status, owner, contact details, custom fields). IRIS CRM Open API: GET /leads/{leadId}.

skip_empty_set.description: Leave out empty field sets from the response.

international_phone_numbers.description: Return phone numbers in E.164 format.

tools.name: iriscrm_list_lead_notes
tools.title: List lead notes
tools.description: List the notes on one lead, optionally from one note tab. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /leads/{leadId}/notes.

tools.name: iriscrm_list_lead_fields
tools.title: List lead fields
tools.description: List the lead field definitions and their ids. Use the ids before reading or updating a field value. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /leads/fields.

specials.description: Special field names to include, for example ['dba', 'phone'].

tools.name: iriscrm_list_merchants
tools.title: List merchants
tools.description: List merchants (processing accounts) with filters by group, processor, merchant id, name, status, active flag, and a date range. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /merchants.

mid.description: Filter by a partial merchant number (a string, so leading zeros are kept).

name.description: Filter by a partial merchant name.

active.description: Filter by the merchant active field.

date_filter.description: Which date the start and end dates apply to.

start_date.description: Start of the date range (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 date-time).

end_date.description: End of the date range (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 date-time).

tools.name: iriscrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List CRM users (sales reps and admins) with their class and active flag. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /users/list.

class.description: Filter by user class id (the class ids are in the IRIS CRM API docs).

active.description: Filter by active status. Omit to get active and deactivated users.
